comments: bb9c27a1: Initializes report generation for pending status by division, physician, or service.
7a25c4a2: Iterates through divisions to generate reports, stopping if user quits.
72c51c77: Generates additional report sections and handles user navigation.
7e8fa982: Exits the report generation process.
62aae6b8: Displays division abbreviation.
4f021cb2: Displays dictation status based on code.
dcbfd722: Retrieves and formats the date of the report.
3ab49ade: Formats and displays the formatted date.
923b5a8b: Displays the first numeric value related to the report.
b48fbfdc: Displays the second numeric value related to the report.
6448bf02: Displays the third numeric value related to the report.
100dc10e: Calculates and displays the sum of the three numeric values, adding to the average.
9c0a2398: Calculates and displays the excess over 30 of the sum, adding to the 30-day average.
994105f3: Marks the end of the process for a section of the report.
5373d0d5: Sets the division identifier for report sections.
f4e0550e: Header for the section displaying pending status information.
204128fc: Marks the end of a division or report section.
66d46f2c: Formats and displays the current date for the report.
5992dea5: Prepares header information if first flag not set.
85bfdeeb: Iterates through physicians to compile and display their reports.
d9033edb: Marks the end of processing for a physician section.
31afb61a: Iterates through patients for a given physician, compiling report details.
9064b98a: Marks the end of the patient iteration process.
f99c65c3: Prepares header information if first flag not set for service section.
54391559: Iterates through services to compile and display their reports.
6e05ffdb: Marks the end of processing for a service section.
bb84569b: Initiates processing for a specific service subsection.
bdc36be3: Marks the end of processing for a specific service subsection.
9f38bda4: Iterates through patients for a given service, compiling report details.
6f238a51: Marks the end of the patient iteration process for services.
148c7327: Prepares the report line for a patient, querying for release information.
1e6c6308: Assigns a physician to the report line if the current section is not physician-based.
2201b8d3: Displays patient name for physician-based reports.
6a2ee525: Displays patient name for service-based reports.
f0dbc21e: Displays patient identifier (BID) for the report.
e214f15f: Displays the date for the report, formatted based on section type.
d22f2104: Displays the associated clinic or location name based on section type.
d8fcb99b: Displays the physician name for service-based reports and calls the header display function.
a9e96f2a: Calls the main header function for the report.
2f5a622b: Generates empty lines to format the report properly.
21fe7498: Handles user navigation for paginated display.
948e433f: Reads user input for navigation, allowing to quit or continue.
ce6f67ad: Handles pagination and header reprinting for detailed sections.
9276cc4c: Marks the end of a report release process section.
5bb17151: Displays the division header for the report.
462423fc: Displays the physician header for the report.
c5a5d617: Displays the service header for the report.
aea12fc3: Displays the specialty header within a service section.
d3adf366: Calls the service section processing function.
